Look up variants by rsID or position

Source: R/variant-lookups.R
og_variants_rsid.Rd

og_variants_rsid() returns the variants the GWAS Stores' own variant tables hold for rsids; og_variants_chrpos() those at positions. They are how you find ALIDs (see vignette("opengwasr")). Each runs as Jobs on the API, split when it is over a Job's limits (1,000 values, 10 GWAS Stores), and waits for them.

Usage

og_variants_rsid(src, rsids, releases = NULL)

og_variants_chrpos(src, positions, releases = NULL)

Arguments

src

A Source, from og_api().

rsids

rsIDs, such as "rs1421085".

releases

Store Releases to use, as in og_analyses().

positions

GRCh38 positions as "chromosome:position", such as "16:53767042" (a chr prefix is allowed).

Value

A data frame with alid, chromosome, position, effect_allele, other_allele, rsid, store_id and release_id, with og_provenance() attached.

Details

You get every match: one row per ALID per Store Release that holds it, so a multiallelic rsID, or a position with several alleles, gives several rows. A value nothing matches has no row. Rows are in the order the Jobs returned them. rsIDs are matched in lower case.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
src <- og_api()
og_variants_rsid(src, "rs1421085", releases = "OGS-00011")
og_variants_chrpos(src, "16:53767042", releases = "OGS-00011")
} # }
